---
name: Bug report
about: Report something that is not working
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior (the prompt you used, the case, the action).

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Logs / screenshots**
Paste relevant log output (run log, server console) or screenshots. Redact any API keys.

**Environment**
- OS: [e.g. macOS 15 arm64, Windows 11]
- OpenFOAM Studio version: [e.g. 1.0.3]
- Docker version: [`docker --version`]
- LLM provider: [Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / local / claude CLI]

**Additional context**
Anything else that might help.
